questions.questionText: What is the net force required to accelerate a 5 kg mass at 4 m/s²?
questions.explanation: According to Newton's Second Law: F = m × a = 5 kg × 4 m/s² = 20 N.

Work done on an object is zero when the angle between Force and Displacement is:
questions.explanation: Work = F × d × cos(θ). Since cos(90°) = 0, Work = 0.

questions.questionText: The momentum of an object of mass m and velocity v is:
questions.explanation: Linear momentum is defined as product of mass and velocity: p = m × v.
